summary: Short kerb beside bush on a street where cars park; steep.

best_section.where: South side of Armadale Street, beside the wooded block just before the driveway

drivers.seclusion: South side backs onto bush; nearest mapped house 16 m at the far end, others 24 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Roadside kerb where a car is parked at the ring; only 9 m long, so a van just fits.
drivers.traffic: Residential street with moderate traffic; cars parked both sides.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Only 9 m of kerb, barely a van length
No Parking Any Time sign sits at the kerb
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the south side gives some shade; open to north and east sun.
